headline: TourMaG reports the intruders got in through an old, unpatched application server.
summary: Added s005, a new TourMaG article (Nov 24; same outlet as s002). New claim c011 (Reported, one outlet): TourMaG says, from its own sources, that the intrusion came through a flaw in an old JBoss 4 application server; the company's president acknowledged the old server and said it should not have been left, but the published quotes do not confirm it as the way in. New question q006 (How did they get in?), answered Reported. c009 now covers only who the attackers are; stays Not established. c004 adds TourMaG's industry sources saying some customers were still not fully back on Monday; stays Reported. c006 adds the credential and key renewals TourMaG describes; stays Reported. c007 adds the company saying nothing critical was hacked; stays Not established. New timeline rows t007 to t010 (TourMaG's reported times). No Travelsoft notice on its own site, no CNIL or ANSSI statement and no ransom claim in the press. headline: Travelsoft says the last customer platform was back on Monday morning, Nov 23.
summary: Added s004, Le Figaro (Nov 23), the first national outlet and a second check independent of Travelsoft. c004 now says all customer platforms were back by Monday morning, per the company's president; it stays Reported (it rests on the company's word). It also notes one travel network saying a small back-office problem remains (from the updated L'Echo touristique article s003). New claim c010: about 60 business customers affected, per the company (Reported, one outlet). c001, c002 and c003 add s004; labels unchanged. c007 adds that nothing so far points to payment or customer personal data, per the company; stays Not established. c008 and c009 add s004; stay Not established. New timeline row t006. No Travelsoft notice on its own site, no CNIL or ANSSI statement and no ransom claim in the press. headline: Travelsoft says all but one customer platform are back and no fraudulent bookings were found.
summary: Added s003, a new L'Echo touristique article (Nov 22; same Travelsoft-affiliated outlet as s001, so not an independent check). c004 now says all customer platforms but one were working by Sunday evening, with the last due Monday, and the B2B site was back; it stays Reported (one outlet). c006 adds that the company asked suppliers to change logins and changed its own passwords; stays Reported, theft not confirmed by the company. c008 adds the company's statement that it found no fraudulent bookings; stays Not established. c009 notes an investigation is under way; stays Not established.
